architecture.summary: Programme-owned manufacturing semantics and lineage dispatch to process-specialized geometry providers; OCCT is isolated behind B-rep validation/reconciliation/STEP adapters; bounded deferred or hybrid representations are allowed locally and must reconcile before topology-dependent/export boundaries.
durable_authority: immutable workpiece revisions and material-body transitions
architecture.external_boundary_rule: No OCCT, Godot, mesh, voxel, or provider-private topology object is part of the stable MSAC/OpenSimachinist contract.
architecture.deployment_default: process-isolated geometry workers until RCS-017 demonstrates a safely narrower concurrency boundary

options.reason: No accepted measurement requires a wholesale fork; it would increase upstream-sync and LGPL-derived-code maintenance cost while leaving journal/provenance/process semantics unsolved.
Immediate B-rep replay works as a baseline but does not capture accepted deferred-topology, specialized-lathe, mill-dispatch and bounded-hybrid findings.
The measured 0.5 mm sparse occupancy candidate erased real 0.001 mm manufacturing features and cannot by itself preserve analytic STEP semantics.

It preserves the implementation-independent journal/lineage contract while admitting the measured lathe specialization, mill hierarchy, bounded topology deferral, OCCT reconciliation and local hybrid escape routes.

components.role: Validate/version canonical operations, immutable revisions, units, coordinate frames and machine/tool/setup revisions.
Own backend-independent body/operation/envelope ancestry and split/merge/replacement/ambiguity relations.
Apply capability, tolerance, uncertainty, reconciliation and provider-dispatch policies without collapsing them into one epsilon.
First-class fixed-axis turning provider for the qualified OD/facing/shoulder/taper/boring/retrace subset.
Dispatch explicit analytic operations, strict recognized/canonicalized paths, exact segment-envelope removal, and bounded fallback rather than one universal freehand batch.
Use isolated OCCT exact/parametric B-rep operations where they are qualified and process-specialized providers do not apply.
Permit regularized material semantics and bounded pending removal/contact state; force reconciliation at connectivity, exact-query, provider-handoff and export boundaries.
Host local cell/mesh/voxel/SDF/exact alternatives with explicit scope/error metadata; never silently promote them to whole-model engineering truth.
Recover known analytic boundaries from semantics/provenance first, resolve pending state, validate bodies, and produce conventional B-rep for topology-dependent use and export.
Export selected material bodies through the four RCS-005 conformance gates; success/refusal is programme-level, not a writer return code.
Contain crashes/hangs/global state with process-isolated workers and timeouts; may be relaxed only by later measured concurrency evidence.

lathe: axisymmetric-provider when support predicate proves rotationally symmetric qualified envelope semantics
batched/generic B-rep fallback for qualified axisymmetric-intent operations not yet implemented by the specialized provider
reconcile and hand off when symmetry/support predicate fails
refuse rather than approximate if no qualified provider preserves requested semantics
mill: strict canonicalized simple path/batch with equivalence proof
bounded local hybrid/deferred fallback for pathological regions when an explicit error contract exists
reconcile or refuse when the fallback cannot meet geometry/STEP requirements
forbidden_shortcuts: one global fuzzy epsilon as manufacturing truth
dense sampled-pose B-rep subtraction as universal fallback

reconciliation_boundaries: provider handoff when representation assumptions change
persistent engineering checkpoint when provider-private state cannot be safely replayed
explicit user/API request for reconciled engineering geometry

tolerance_policy.uncertain_contact: defer/reconcile while retaining signed manufacturing intent
tolerance_policy.positive_removal: never silently converted to a no-op by numerical/fuzzy/manufacturing tolerance
tolerance_policy.retrace_elision: requires semantic-lineage proof and preserves the journal event

external_api.transport: not selected; schema semantics are stable before RPC/ABI choice

versioning.replay_rule: A saved project remains defined by canonical manufacturing intent and semantic revisions. Provider-private geometry caches may be invalidated and rebuilt; replay records the implementation/profile used for diagnostics and reproducibility.
versioning.migration_rule: Schema migrations transform programme-owned semantic data explicitly; they do not reinterpret backend-private topology IDs.

dependency_strategy.occt: Keep pinned and isolated behind programme adapters. Prefer shared-library use and explicit per-call parameters. Do not deep-fork unless a measured narrow seam cannot be corrected above the kernel.
dependency_strategy.optional_fallbacks: Manifold/OpenVDB-style or exact-geometry libraries may be introduced behind optional replaceable adapters after workload-specific qualification.
dependency_strategy.cgal_nef: Not an initial mandatory dependency; GPL-3+ package licensing and analytic reconstruction cost are material constraints.
dependency_strategy.provenance: Record exact dependency versions/commits/build profiles and preserve applicable notices/source obligations.
